clusters.title: Where a local kit is built and what its install steps and lifecycle hooks can reach (host side or microVM, network, filesystem) is stated nowhere and measured by no probe, although personal-kit install steps and hooks are agent-authored code admitted at gate 2.

An adopter writing a first personal kit cannot tell whether a download in an install step is refused, works or fails offline.
clusters.change: In 06 6.1, Build row, add: 'Where sbx runs a local kit's install steps and lifecycle hooks, and what they reach (network, host paths, uid), is measured by A11 and A14 (11 11.1).
